map.Token 数量估算器，根据文本长度估算大模型 token 数量，帮助用户把控上: Estimates the number of large-model tokens from text length, helping users keep the context window and API cost under control.
map.估算 token 数 = ⌈字符数 × 语言系数 / 重叠系数⌉；英文参考 =: Estimated tokens = ⌈characters × language factor / overlap factor⌉; English reference = ⌈characters × 0.3 / 1.5⌉; cost ≈ tokens / 10⁶ × unit price
map.不同语言与分词器的压缩率差异很大：中文常约 1–1.5 字符/token，英文约: Compression ratios differ a lot by language and tokenizer: Chinese is often about 1-1.5 characters per token, English about 4 characters per token. This formula gives an order-of-magnitude estimate; exact billing requires the model's official tokenizer. Code and numbers split into finer pieces, so the actual token count is often higher than a plain-text estimate.
map.根据文本长度与语言比例估算大模型 token 数，帮助用户把控上下文窗口。: Estimate the large-model token count from text length and language mix, helping keep the context window under control.
map.中文约每 1~2 字 1 token，英文约每 4 字符 1 token，具体随: Chinese is roughly 1 token per 1-2 characters and English about 1 token per 4 characters, depending on the tokenizer.
map.估算用于预判 API 调用成本与是否触发上下文截断。: The estimate helps predict API cost and whether context truncation will be triggered.
map.：一段 800 中文字的文本，按 1.5 字/token 估算≈533 toke: For an 800-Chinese-character passage at 1.5 characters per token the estimate is about 533 tokens; adding 200 English words gives about 260 tokens, for a total near 793 tokens, about 80% of a 1k context window.
map.估算和真实计费差多少？: How far is the estimate from real billing?
map.量级基本一致，精确值取决于具体模型分词器；中文差异可能被放大数倍，正式计费以厂商: The order of magnitude is usually right, but the exact value depends on the model tokenizer; the gap for Chinese can be several times larger. Use the token count returned by the vendor for official billing.
map.怎么避免超出上下文？: How do I avoid exceeding the context window?
map.先在本地估算文本 token，长文本做摘要或分块，预留生成空间(通常留 20%~: Estimate the text tokens locally first, summarize or chunk long text, and reserve room for generation (usually 20%-30%) to avoid losing information to truncation.
